# Third-party register

This directory contains ONLY license records, manifests and review notes. No third-party asset binaries are bundled in this deliverable. For licensed/paid assets, store source artifacts only in permitted private locations and import into Unity according to license; do not commit restricted sources to a public repository.

Add each dependency to `manifest.csv`, verify original provider license and attribution/redistribution conditions; the value `verify` means **not legally approved yet**.
